text.text_excerpt: I've been lucky enough to live a block away from Gulf Pizza since I moved to the Point several years ago. It can be a little difficult to figure out their hours, but when you catch them open you can score an amazing pizza. (The previous reviewer who said they have the same hours as a Bywater in-home anarchist bicycle shop wasn't really kidding) The Bounty Beast is hands down one of the best pizzas in New Orleans. As an East Coast transplant (yuck, I know) pizza is one of the few foods I've found to be lacking in New Orleans. Pizza snobs, this is your joint. If you're not local, come check out an awesome, little known neighborhood and make a date night out of some Gulf Pizza.

This is as good as it gets in New Orleans. Wonderful crispy crust and very fresh, tasty ingredients. My husband who scoffs at me for eating cheese pizza loves the cheese pizza with lots of flavor offered by Gulf. Also the Bounty Beast with roasted garlic, tomatoes, multiple meats,etc....is one of the most delicious pizzas ever! Go Gulf (outside seating only)

I was impressed with Gulf Pizza. I knew beforehand that they only had a few outside tables, so I ordered take-out. They told me it would be ready in 20 minutes, and they were right on the button. I ordered the Seguin-with sausage, tomatoes, black olives and roasted garlic. The pizza had a thin crispy crust topped with their flavorful gulf sauce and mozzarella. It was quite pleasing to the palate and not greasy at all. I'll definitely be back.
